about_the_game:
The classic Endless War series returns — bigger, bolder, and deadlier than ever.
Dive into a brutal reimagining of World War II, where every bullet counts, every skirmish is a tactical puzzle, and survival depends not on firepower, but on cunning. From the icy fjords of Norway to the steamy jungles of Okinawa, the battlefield awaits.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Arsenal
    Wield everything from iconic staples like the M1 Garand to rare, experimental prototypes scavenged from history’s edges.

  • Hardcore Combat
    You’re not a superhero, not the chosen one. You’re just a soldier — and it only takes a few bullets to end your story. The same goes for your enemies.

  • Tactics is the Key
    Outsmart the enemy: bait them into friendly fire, sow chaos with grenades, or bring down entire buildings to eliminate entrenched foes.

Five Campaigns. Five Sides. One Relentless War.

  • United States
    From the Pacific frontlines and nighttime raids in Normandy to the brutal assault on Iwo Jima.

  • Soviet Union
    Relive the Eastern Front — from the first days of the invasion, through the fires of Stalingrad, to the final push into Berlin.

  • Germany
    Fight desperate battles on the Volga, then hold the line as the Reich crumbles around you.

  • Japan
    Engage in forgotten island skirmishes and march through the bloodied streets of Singapore.

  • United Kingdom
    From the sands of El Alamein, through the jungles of Indochina, to the war-torn streets of Athens.

name: Endless War

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Fast-paced top-down WWII shooter where reflexes and tactics are key. Dodge bullets, use cover, and outsmart enemies in intense firefights from Stalingrad to Okinawa. One roll, one shot — that's the difference between victory and death.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Turkish
